# DB Connections

Database connections of a project. The API reads them, without connection properties or secrets; create and change them in the dashboard. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/db-connections` | [List db connections](#get-db-connections) |
| `GET` | `/v1/db-connections/{db_connection_id}` | [Get a db connection](#get-db-connection) |

---

## List db connections {: #get-db-connections }

```http
GET /v1/db-connections
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List db connections | array of [DbConnection](#dbconnection) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/db-connections' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

---

## Get a db connection {: #get-db-connection }

```http
GET /v1/db-connections/{db_connection_id}
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `db_connection_id` | path | integer | Yes | Db connection ID |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Get a db connection | [DbConnection](#dbconnection) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Db connection not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/db-connections/<db_connection_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

### ApiErrorCode {: #apierrorcode }

One of: `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, `NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `INVALID_LICENSE`, `BAD_REQUEST`.

### StableProfilingLocation {: #stableprofilinglocation }

One of: `source-database`, `digna-engine`.

### StableDbConnectionProfilingMode {: #stabledbconnectionprofilingmode }

One of: `permanent`, `session`, `standard`.

### StableDbConnectionTechnology {: #stabledbconnectiontechnology }

One of: `hive`, `postgres`, `oracle`, `sqlserver`, `databricks`, `teradata`, `netezza`, `snowflake`, `impala`.
